title: mockServerResponse
description: Information about the mock server's response.

createdAt.description: The date and time at which the server response was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time at which the server response was last updated.

statusCode.description: The server response's 5xx HTTP response code.

headers.description: The server response's request headers key-value pairs, such as Content-Type, Accept, encoding, and other information.

language.description: The server response's body language type.

body.description: The server response's body that returns when calling the mock server.

createdBy.description: The user ID of the user who created the server response.

updatedBy.description: The user ID of the user who last updated the server response.
